raw_response: {"diagnosis":"Reversals arrive as separate REVERSAL rows (orig_txn_id points at the original), and the original rows in recent batches are still status POSTED. silver_transactions keeps those originals, so recent days are overstated against settlement. Older originals were already flipped to REVERSED and are excluded, which is why only recent days are off.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.7,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(t.txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, t.customer_id, CAST(t.merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(t.amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(t.txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(t.txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions t WHERE t.status = 'POSTED' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM raw_transactions r WHERE r.status = 'REVERSAL' AND r.orig_txn_id = t.txn_id)"}}
